fix.name: cancel_fair
fix.expr: ok and called("cancel") and wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) > wide(pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesDeposited") - pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))
fix.why: cancel pays out at most the fraction of the pool matching the lock's truly outstanding shares (deposited - withdrawn); the stored 'shares' field may itself be stale, so the rule must not trust it

fix.name: no_third_party_token_loss
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
fix.why: nobody loses tokens in a call they did not make; direct MockToken.transferFrom by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

add.name: create_fair
add.expr: ok and called("createLock") and pre("totalShares") > 0 and pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) > 0 and wide(post("totalShares") - pre("totalShares")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) > wide(arg(1)) * wide(pre("totalShares"))
add.why: a new lock gets no more shares than its fair fraction of the pool

add.name: cancel_creator_bounded
add.expr: ok and called("cancel") and pre("locks", arg(0), "creator") != pre("locks", arg(0), "beneficiary") and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", pre("locks", arg(0), "creator")) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", pre("locks", arg(0), "creator"))) * wide(pre("totalShares")) > wide(pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesDeposited") - pre("locks", arg(0), "sharesWithdrawn")) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))
add.why: on cancel the creator gets at most the outstanding (unreleased) part of the lock, never tokens already released or belonging to other locks
